title: Who should you reach out to after applying to a job? ✍️
description:
If you’re looking to send an email to a recruiter but the company you’re reaching out to has more than one how do you know which one to email? Even though it’s a bit of a confusing topic, the best answer we have is first look for a recruiter specific to your department. If you find one awesome, but if not you can always include in your message asking for the right one. #linkedin #linkedintips #jobsearch #jobsearchtips
